en: The prototype of the Moon Gundam.
Bargil from "Mobile Suit MOON Gundam" is commercialized in the HG series.
The characteristic aircraft form such as the head, funnel, and container are reproduced with new modeling.
● Reproduce the characteristic aircraft form with new modeling!
The head, funnel, container, etc. are reproduced with new modeling, and the characteristic purple body coloring is reproduced with molding color.
head
The characteristic head equipped with a mono-eye is reproduced with new modeling.
backpack
A funnel container that can store three funnels on each side.
The backpack equipped with a propellant tank is reproduced with new modeling.
● Comes with a variety of weapons including funnels, beam rifles, beam tomahawks, etc.
funnel
The six funnels ejected from the backpack are reproduced with new modeling!
butterfly edge
A combat weapon attached to the arm of the aircraft.
● Includes MarkingSeal that reproduces the marks in various places.
Attached weapons: Beam Tomahawk / Beam Rifle / Butterfly Edge / Funnel
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
